source: Cash flow calendar conventions, from the reference spec (cashflow v9 to v44) and Eli's corrections; card terms from the CFPB and issuer agreements as remembered by the builder

cards.note: A card with no statement day is assumed to close on the 15th and be due 24 days later. The minimum is the larger of 2% of the statement and $25. A missed payment costs the late fee and the penalty rate for six months.

floor.note: The cash floor is the lean month step of the cushion when it is funded, else zero; the coach can set a fixed amount.

checkin.note: Across check-ins, a mean miss larger than the spread of the misses reads as a steady lean, not noise.

words.tight: It fits, but it makes a tight day tighter.
words.no: Not this time. It would push a day under the floor.
